entities.summary: Bansuri Swaraj is an Indian lawyer and politician. She is a member of Lok Sabha from New Delhi. Bansuri Swaraj is the daughter of former Union Minister Sushma Swaraj and former Governor of Mizoram Swaraj Kaushal.
